\begin{document}
A group\index{group} is a set with an operation such that $a(bc) = (ab)c$,
as in~\cite{groups}. Its order\index{group!order} is finite when
\begin{equation}
  |G| = \sum_{g \in G} 1 < \infty.
\end{equation}
